headline: FBI and USDA reportedly hacked again, with FBI police database targeted
summary: The FBI and USDA were reportedly hacked, with the FBI breach reportedly targeting its National Crime Information Center, used to share data among federal, state and local law enforcement, for the second time in two months. The FBI is reportedly investigating; President Trump called the reported hack "not good"; and it remains unclear who is responsible for either incident.
